notesEn: Night mode now turns on automatically at night (7 PM - 7 AM) or when your phone is in dark mode, on the website and in the app. The theme button still saves your own choice.
notesHi: Ab raat (7 PM - 7 AM) ya phone dark mode par website aur app me night mode khud lag jayega. Theme button se aapki pasand ab save bhi hogi.
